summary: E16 §6 per-hop ACL read-through projection for the process card «Запись-источник» (live-proof T-0691 P1). GET /api/processes/:id gains (1) a PARTICIPANT tier — a caller who acts on the instance (holds its task role / acted on it / owner) but lacks source-record READ now gets the instance skeleton + a SAFE sourceRecord projection {id,title,typeLabel,canOpen,appId?} with NO variables/history, instead of the T-0721 404; (2) an embedded sourceRecord on the reader tier. RecordRef renders the server title directly (no records/:id fetch → no raw-UUID fallback); the «открыть» link is offered ONLY when canOpen (READ-PDP ∧ sandbox-openable), so it never dead-ends in a 404. Reader tier (T-0721 variables/history) is byte-identical; non-participant+no-READ still 404 (fail-closed).

security_notes: Safe projection exposes ONLY {id, title, typeLabel, canOpen, appId?}; record.data (all other fields) never serialized on the participant path; variables/history stay reader-only (T-0721 threat surface unchanged).

title = schema-designated title field (pickTitleFieldKey, T-0613) or neutral «{type}·id8» — never an arbitrary data-order scan, so no incidental field value leaks (SECRET_VALUE asserted absent in SRP-5).
canOpen = isRecordReadable (READ-PDP, T-0570) AND sandbox-openable (resolveActorPrivilege, T-0557 — the SAME resolver records.ts uses); the link never over-promises a records/:id that would 404.

Participant = getRoleSlugsForActor (ACTOR_ACTIVE-gated, T-0738) ∪ instance-audit-actor ∪ isGenesisOwnerForTenant (deactivation-safe, T-0658); deactivated actors fail-closed. Tenant/RLS untouched; every new read tenant-scoped.
deviations_from_adr: ADR §1.5 chose the entry point AS the process detail response (embed sourceRecord + participant tier) over a separate /api/records/:id/projection endpoint — reuses the merged T-0721 authority path in-place and delivers the projection PRE-RESOLVED so RecordRef makes no records/:id fetch. Matches the task's 'предпочти ту, что реюзает уже смерженный authority-путь T-0721'.

canOpen additionally accounts for the sandbox/draft gate (not only READ-PDP as the task wording literally states): live-proof analysis (spec §0.1) proves the observed 404 is the sandbox gate (the acting approver HAS READ-PDP — she saw the full process card, which T-0721 gates on READ — so her records/:id 404 is draft-tier masking). canOpen must reflect real openability or the «открыть» link dead-ends.
follow_ups: The P0 triage-parking finding of T-0691 (create=start stalls at the agent step) is T-0755, out of scope here.
Process-definition-scoped read grants for record-LESS instances (T-0714 §5 phase 3) remain a follow-up; a record-less instance carries no sourceRecord (unchanged).
judge_attack_surface: Try a non-participant tenant member with no READ on a record-bound instance → must stay 404 (SRP-2).
Try to read record.data fields (beyond the single designated title) or variables/history via the participant tier → must be absent (SRP-5).
Try a deactivated role-holder / deactivated owner → participant resolvers are ACTOR_ACTIVE/deactivation-gated → must fail-closed.
Try canOpen:true on a draft-tier record you can't actually open → SRP-4 pins canOpen:false for the non-creator reader.
